claims.statement: At the 28 April 2015 Accor general assembly, a shareholder asked Bazin whether he would accept compensation equal to the French minimum wage (SMIC), as Tesla's CEO had.

citations.quote: Lors de l'assemblée générale d'Accor, un actionnaire demande au PDG, Sébastien Bazin, s'il accepterait de faire comme le PDG de Tesla, avoir une rémunération égale au SMIC.

sections.summary: The person featured is Sébastien Bazin. Sébastien Bazin was PDG (CEO) of Accor as of the Accor general assembly on 28 April 2015. At the 28 April 2015 Accor general assembly, a shareholder asked Bazin whether he would accept compensation equal to the French minimum wage (SMIC), as Tesla's CEO had.
